_about: Cases for strip_chrome (V17) and clean_ok (V16). All invented.
⚠ THE UNIT IS UNICODE CODE POINTS OVER THE NFC-NORMALISED STRING, and the
two rejected units are represented here on purpose so a future reader can
see that they give a DIFFERENT answer rather than take the choice on
trust: `cjk_30` is 30 characters and 90 UTF-8 bytes, and `decomposed_29`
is 58 code points raw and 29 after NFC.
⚠ A4 — these chrome patterns are NOT #40's. The measured leftover count
with the research's own patterns was 167 of 3,748 (4.5%) against the
ticket's 173 (5%). The SHAPE is confirmed; the exact number will differ,
so 173 is approximate and NO GATE MAY PIN IT. Nothing in this file counts

cases.name: pure_chrome_only
cases.why: a status bar and one bar label and nothing else — the clean fails and the picture stays a picture. ⚠ CR-03 CHANGED THE DECLARED `cleaned` FROM "" TO "Done", and the change is the whole trade recorded as a value: the bar label now SURVIVES the strip. It is left in on purpose, because the only way to delete it was a rule that also deleted her own `Done`, `Back`, `完成` and `更多`. `clean_ok` is still false — four characters is nowhere near the 30-code-point floor — so this picture still stays a picture, which is what the case was really protecting.
cases.text: 9:41 LTE 100% Done

cases.name: boundary_29
cases.why: 29 code points after stripping — no note. The chrome is what pushed it under, which is the whole point of stripping first.
cases.text: 9:41 100% aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

cases.name: boundary_30
cases.why: exactly 30 code points after stripping — a note. The comparison is `>=`.
cases.text: 9:41 100% aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

cases.name: cjk_30
cases.why: THE NAMED ENCODING CASE. Exactly 30 Chinese characters and exactly 90 UTF-8 bytes. Thirty means thirty in both languages; a byte threshold would have made it roughly three times stricter here, which is the exact asymmetry this phase exists to remove.
cases.text: 今天天气很好我去公园散步看见很多人在跑步打太极拳心情真的非常
cases.cleaned: 今天天气很好我去公园散步看见很多人在跑步打太极拳心情真的非常

cases.name: cjk_29
cases.why: 29 Chinese characters — no note, on the same rule that gives 29 Latin ones no note.
cases.text: 今天天气很好我去公园散步看见很多人在跑步打太极拳心情真的非

cases.name: decomposed_29
cases.why: THE NAMED NORMALISATION CASE. 29 e-acute written DECOMPOSED: 58 code points raw, 29 after NFC. Without the normalisation this would pass on 58; with it, it correctly fails on 29. Vision may return decomposed forms and a decomposed string has more code points than its composed equal. ⚠ The literal below is genuinely decomposed (e + U+0301) and an editor that recomposed it would silently turn this case into a no-op — so the suite asserts `raw_code_points` BY VALUE against the fixture before it asserts anything about clean_ok.
cases.text: ééééééééééééééééééééééééééééé

cases.name: decomposed_30
cases.why: 30 decomposed e-acute: 60 code points raw, 30 after NFC — a note, on the same rule.
cases.text: éééééééééééééééééééééééééééééé

cases.name: chinese_affordances
cases.why: ⚠ REWRITTEN FOR CR-03. This case used to say 'the Chinese bar words are chrome in exactly the way their English twins are' — and that sentence was the defect, written down as an expectation. 取消 and 完成 are ordinary Chinese words, so the rule that deleted them here also deleted them out of her prose (measured: 18 and 102 occurrences in her own minted notes). They now SURVIVE, and the clock still goes. A bar label left in a note is visible and harmless; a deleted word is neither.
